stem: Solution Preparation from Concentrated Stock: Concentrated hydrochloric acid is labeled as $37.0\%$ $\text{HCl}$ by mass with a density of $1.19\text{~g/mL}$. How many milliliters of this stock solution are needed to prepare $500.0\text{~mL}$ of $0.200\text{~M~HCl}$? ($\text{MW~of~HCl} = 36.46\text{~g/mol}$)
